title: mandevilla fragrans
intro: Mandevilla fragrans, commonly known as the "Frangipani vine," is a tropical evergreen climber native to South America, belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress due to its sedative properties, as well as promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Mandevilla fragrans include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, reducing muscle spasms and cramps, and its antiseptic properties, which aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Mandevilla fragrans include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
